n848a70a8a6.headline: Saudi Arabia and Russia's revenues from the OPEC+ deal amounted to $40 billion
n848a70a8a6.summary: Russia and Saudi Arabia each received $40 billion in additional income due to the OPEC+ agreement, which helped keep oil prices above $35 per barrel.
n848a70a8a6.why: Saudi Arabia and Russia are major oil producers whose revenues significantly impact global energy markets and national economies. The OPEC+ deal influences oil supply and prices worldwide.
n848a70a8a6.why_moved: The OPEC+ production agreement limited supply, supporting oil prices above $35 per barrel, boosting revenues for Saudi Arabia and Russia.
